subject: general
question: P is any point inside the rectangle ABCD. If PA = 98 cm, PB = 91 cm and PC = 21 cm, then the length of PD (in cm) is equal to:
solution:
**Given:**

PA = 98 cm

PB = 91 cm

PC = 21 cm

**Formula Used:**

PA² + PC² = PB² + PD²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3090aea8cd588f9b479deb3886044abc45ffbd86b1a43f9fbefd5f8ac1e52e09.png] 

⇒ (98)² + (21)² = (91)² + PD²

⇒ 9604 + 441 = 8281 + PD²

⇒ 10045 = 8281 + PD²

⇒ PD² = 10045 - 8281

⇒ PD² = 1764

⇒ PD = √1764

⇒ PD = 42 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 42.**
